title: Free Online Editors: LaTeX, SVG, Markdown and More | giit.ch
desc: Free browser editors for LaTeX, SVG, HTML, Markdown, JSON, YAML, CSV, Typst and more, with a live preview. No sign-up, no ads, files stay in your browser.
og_title: giit Editors - free online editors with a live preview
h1: Free online editors with a live preview, right in your browser
lead: Editors for the files you work with every day: LaTeX, SVG, HTML, Markdown, data formats and more. Code on the left, the result on the right, nothing to install, and your files stay in your browser. Any AI can write into them with a link, and you can put any of them into your own website.

common_sub: Learn one, and you know them all.
common: The editors keep your documents in your browser (local storage), not on our server. A document goes to a server only if you set up your own (webhook), or if a website opens it in an editor with a form - our server then passes it on without storing it.
Keep any number of documents in the browser: open, rename, duplicate, download and delete them, each with its own undo history.
Any AI can write with you
Click "AI Assistant", then "Copy prompt", and paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot. The AI answers with a link that opens its result in your editor - Undo takes it back.
In browsers with WebMCP, an AI agent can read and change the open document directly; every change is an undo step.
A dot on the AI button shows whether an AI is connected: through your website, as a browser agent, or by links in this tab.
Change text, values or shapes right in the preview, tree, table or canvas; the code follows. How you edit depends on the format.
A webhook sends every saved version to an address you choose, with a token - automatically or on Ctrl+S.

Every editor has a page in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean - /de/, /fr/ … The language menu switches, the choice is remembered. The AI prompt always stays in English.
Every editor follows your system or the theme you choose, and works on phones and tablets.
embed_h: Use an editor in your own website
embed_teaser: Every editor can be put into another website with an iframe or in a window of its own, and all of them speak the same postMessage protocol. Each editor has a page for developers with examples for your page and your server:
embed_sub: All editors speak the same protocol. Replace latex with svg, html, md, json, yaml, toml, xml, csv, typst, shls or qr - the messages are the same, only their prefix changes (latexeditor:, svgeditor: …).
steps: Put the editor into your page
An iframe is enough. ?embed=1 shows the reduced view with a Save button, ?save=0 hides it when your page has its own. The address chooses the language: /de/ for German, /fr/ for French and so on.
Load your document, receive changes and saves
The editor says it is ready, your page sends the document, and the editor reports real edits and every Save. Check the origin of every message.
Or open it in a window of its own
The full editor in its own window talks to window.opener in exactly the same way - and links from an AI reach it there.
Let an AI deliver straight to your server

Hand the editor your rules, an https address on your own site and one key for this editor session. "Copy prompt" then tells the AI to POST its result there; your page opens it in the editor. Keep the key valid only while the editor is open.

faq: Yes. No sign-up and no ads. We set no limit on the number of documents; only your browser's storage does.

No. The editors run in your browser and keep your documents there, not on our server. A document goes to a server only if you set up a webhook, if a website that embeds an editor saves it on its own server, or if a website opens it in an editor with a form - our server then passes it on without storing it. As on any website, the server logs each visit, and we count page views anonymously.
Any AI - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or the AI in your coding tool. Copy the prompt, say what you want, and click the link the AI answers with.
Can I use an editor on my own website?
Yes. Embed it with an iframe or open it in its own window and exchange documents with postMessage, or let it send saved versions to your server with a webhook.
How do I get the editor in my language?
Choose it in the language menu at the top, or open its page directly: /de/ for German, /fr/ for French, /ja/ for Japanese and so on. The editor remembers it. The prompt for the AI stays English.

editors.latex: Write LaTeX and see the typeset pages as you type. Add pictures, set paper and margins, export to PDF.
editors.svg: SVG as code and on a canvas: move, resize and recolor shapes, snap grid, export to PNG, JPG, WebP or React.
editors.html: Write HTML with a live preview, edit text right in the preview, keep pictures with the page, export as one file or a ZIP.
editors.md: Markdown, the simple format for notes and documentation, with tables, task lists, footnotes and math; export to HTML or PDF.
editors.json: JSON and JSON Lines as code and as a foldable tree: edit keys and values in the tree, check against a JSON Schema, convert to YAML, CSV or XML.
editors.yaml: YAML with the same data tree, comments and anchors kept, problems with their line, convert to JSON.
editors.toml: TOML for pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml and app settings, with the same data tree: comments kept, strict TOML 1.0 checks, convert to JSON or YAML.
editors.xml: XML with an element tree, XPath search, a check for errors and conversion to JSON or YAML.
editors.csv: CSV as text and as a spreadsheet-like table, also for large files; export to XLSX, JSON, Markdown or HTML tables.
editors.shls: SHLS, a compact data format for AI: key blocks and records as a tree, problems with their line, conversion to and from JSON the same way as the reference code.
editors.typst: Typst with the real compiler in the browser: pages as you type, PDF with selectable text, pictures stored with the document.
editors.qr: QR codes for links, WiFi, contacts and payments (SEPA, Swiss QR bill) with logo and design, checked by scanning, as SVG, PDF or EPS - static codes without an expiration date.
